_comment: Tier-2 for skfem convection_diffusion#2, a class-location correction. Measured on skfem 12.0.1: MeshTri / MeshQuad / MeshLine have NO `periodic` attribute; MeshTri1DG / MeshQuad1DG / MeshLine1DG all do, with signature (mesh, ix, ix0); and no top-level skfem name contains 'periodic'. So the incantation is MeshTri1DG.periodic(m, ix, ix0), not MeshTri.periodic(...).
